faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most common questions about our legal services

faq1.question: What legal services does the firm provide?
faq1.answer: We provide a comprehensive range of legal services including official documentation, contract and agreement drafting, legal representation, and legal consultations in various fields.

faq2.question: How long does the official documentation process take?
faq2.answer: The documentation duration varies depending on the type and complexity of the document, but most simple documents can be completed on the same day, while complex documents may take 3-7 business days.

faq3.question: Do you provide free legal consultations?

faq4.question: What are the legal fees and service charges?
faq4.answer: Fees vary depending on the type of service and case complexity. We clarify all costs upfront before starting any legal work.

faq5.question: Can I contact you outside official working hours?
faq5.answer: Yes, we provide 24/7 WhatsApp support for urgent cases. You can also leave a message and we will contact you as soon as possible.

faq6.question: In which areas do you provide your services?
faq6.answer: Our main office is in Dammam - Al-Husam district, and we provide our services throughout the Kingdom. We also provide remote consultations when needed.
